<a id="where-the-possible-grows--可能者于何处增长"></a>
# Where the possible grows

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-the-possible-grows` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](where-the-possible-grows.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The possible relative to what is held grows only across steps changing what is held, and keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Along a course of a stated process nothing is added to the whole possible, a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top included.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A move adds nothing to the possible under its process. For any process Q, what is possible under Q from a configuration Q reaches is possible from the first; so where something possible under Q from t is not possible from s, Q does not reach t from s, and a step from s to t is not a move of Q. (`Becoming.Reaching.not_reach_of_grows`, `Becoming.Reaching.not_step_of_grows`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. Keeping widening needs departures without end. Along a course, where every step of a stretch is a move of Q, what is possible under Q at its end is possible at its start; so where the possible under Q keeps widening, read from the course's first step, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of moves of Q throughout, and where every step from some step on is one, it does not keep widening. (`Becoming.Run.possible_of_stretch`, `Becoming.Run.departs_of_keepsWidening`, `Becoming.Run.not_keepsWidening_of_within`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. A course that returns. Along a course that comes back to one configuration at arbitrarily late steps, nothing read off its configurations keeps widening: neither the possible under any process nor the possible with any part held. (`Becoming.Run.not_keepsWidening_of_returns`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. The possible with a part held. For a relation Same on configurations, read as a part held unchanged, the moves holding it are the moves of the process with Same between their two configurations, and the held possible is the possible under them; it is included in the whole possible, and holding a weaker relation reaches at least as much. (`Becoming.Reaching.heldMoves`, `Becoming.Reaching.PossibleHeld`, `Becoming.Reach.of_heldMoves`, `Becoming.Reach.heldMoves_mono`, `Becoming.Reaching.PossibleHeld.possible`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Instances. Onward's steps within a family are the moves holding both ends in it, and Junctures' steps after which a configuration can still be had are the moves holding that, both by definition. (`Becoming.Onward.within_eq_heldMoves`, `Becoming.Branching.keeping_eq_heldMoves`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. On the root. With Same in the place of the grammar's class, any relation, a move holding it is a continuation «续» under it; what the moves holding it reach is the start or the start's line «相续» under it; and the held possible is what the start or that line admits. (`Becoming.Reaching.steps_heldMoves_iff`, `Becoming.Reaching.reach_heldMoves_iff`, `Becoming.Reaching.possibleHeld_iff_line`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Held move by move, and as at the start. Where Same is a class, what the moves holding it reach is alike the start under it, and holding it move by move is holding it as it is at the start, both ways: what the moves holding Same reach from s is what the moves into configurations alike s reach. (`Becoming.Reach.same_of_heldMoves`, `Becoming.Trace.heldMoves_sameAsStart`, `Becoming.Trace.sameAsStart_heldMoves`, `Becoming.Reach.heldMoves_iff_sameAsStart`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. Where it grows. Where something possible with the part held at the next step is not possible so at the present one, the step changes the part; where every step from T on holds the part, what is possible with it held at step T + d is possible so at T: from the step at which the part stays for good, nothing is added. (`Becoming.Run.changes_of_heldGrows`, `Becoming.Run.possibleHeld_of_stays`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. Where it keeps widening. The held possible keeps widening only where the part changes without end: from every step some bounded stretch does not hold the part throughout, so not along a course whose steps hold it from some step on; and only where no list holds the whole possible from the course's start. (`Becoming.Run.changes_of_heldKeepsWidening`, `Becoming.Run.not_heldKeepsWidening_of_stays`, `Becoming.Run.not_heldKeepsWidening_of_listed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
10. Located where holding is decided. Where whether each step of the course holds the part is decided, a step changing it lies between N and N + d wherever something possible with it held at N + d is not possible so at N, and where the held possible keeps widening such a step recurs from every step on. (`Becoming.Run.held_change_located`, `Becoming.Run.held_change_recurs_of_keepsWidening`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
11. Read on the course's moments. With the part between two moments in the place of the class, where the held possible keeps widening, from no moment is the course's line under the part unending «不穷»; and where holding is also decided, a line under the part begins «生» after every moment. (`Becoming.Run.not_unending_of_heldKeepsWidening`, `Becoming.Run.begins_of_heldKeepsWidening`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
12. On the map. Read along the steps with the one as the coarse class, a moment is 全生成 at a class exactly where a line under it begins after every later moment; so where holding is decided and the held possible keeps widening, every moment is 全生成 at (the one, what is held), and so where what is held changes at every step. A restatement; not conversely. (`Becoming.Steps.generation_iff_begins`, `Becoming.Run.generation_of_heldKeepsWidening`, `Becoming.Run.generation_of_held_changes`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
13. Witnesses on the map. Every moment of the raised rule is 全生成 under the rule held while every moment ceases: generation without renewal without end. On the rule raised every other step, every moment is 全生成 beside renewal without end and keeping widening. On the oscillating rule every moment is 全生成 while the held possible does not keep widening. (`Becoming.RaisedRule.generation`, `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.begins_after_even`, `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.generation`, `Becoming.Oscillating.generation`, `Becoming.Oscillating.generation_without_widening`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
14. A rule changing its own rule. On adaptive F G a step keeps the rule exactly where G leaves it as it is; so the possible with the rule held keeps widening only where G changes the rule without end, located from every step on where rules are decided; nothing is added to the whole possible (Run.possible_of_next at adaptive F G). (`Becoming.adaptive_keeps_rule_iff`, `Becoming.Run.adaptive_rule_changes_of_keepsWidening`, `Becoming.Run.adaptive_rule_change_recurs_of_keepsWidening`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
15. Every possibility with some member of a sequence held. On the root, for every carrier and relation R: on a sequence of relations E n, each included in every later one, where every step of R is alike under some member, whatever R reaches lies on a line under some member; so where every move of a process holds some member, what it reaches it reaches with some member held, and so every possibility. (`Becoming.«及在渐粗列之相续»`, `Becoming.Reaching.reach_held_of_sequence`, `Becoming.Reaching.possible_iff_held_of_sequence`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
16. A tower of rules with no top. A state and a sequence of rules: the move 0 changes the state as the rule at height 0 allows, the move k + 1 the rule at height k as the rule at height k + 1 allows, all else kept, so each rule changes only as the one above it allows. The move a keeps the rules from height a up, a class coarser with the height, so each possibility is had with the rules from some height up held. (`Becoming.RuleTower.process`, `Becoming.RuleTower.SameFrom`, `Becoming.RuleTower.SameFrom.mono`, `Becoming.RuleTower.sameFrom_class`, `Becoming.RuleTower.step_sameFrom`, `Becoming.RuleTower.possible_iff_held`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
17. The premise is needed. The same scheme changing every rule at once has a possibility needing the whole tower: with each rule growing by the one above it, 2 is possible from all rules at 1, but not with the rules from any height up held, each move changing every rule. (`Becoming.RuleTower.synchronous`, `Becoming.Synchronous.process`, `Becoming.Synchronous.adm`, `Becoming.Synchronous.start`, `Becoming.Synchronous.possible_two`, `Becoming.Synchronous.not_held`, `Becoming.Synchronous.tower_law_fails`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
18. Along a course of the tower. Where the possible with the rules from height n up held keeps widening, moves above n, the only moves that can change a rule from height n up, recur from every step on, located with no decision of the rules since each move names the one height it can change; the moves at most n reflect that possible, so every origin of it passes a move above n (Gated.origin). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each law holds on every process with what each configuration admits given, or on a witness; the located forms take holding decided along the course, or rules decided; the sequence law takes each member included in every later one and every move holding some member.
- Modelling choices: discrete steps; the held part a relation on configurations read move by move, the same as holding it as at the start for a class, not in general; formations compared by name over one fixed type; keeping widening read from the course's first step; the tower's rules a sequence indexed by the natural numbers, each move keeping the rules from some height up, its scheme fixed.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That growth relative to what is held is growth of the whole possible: along a course of a stated process the whole possible never grows.
- A sufficient condition for keeping widening relative to what is held, beyond the witnesses: endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice.
- Where a change of a general part is located without deciding each step's holding: the law then gives a bounded stretch not holding it throughout, not a step.
- That a move above n changes a rule: the tower's law locates moves that can change a rule from height n up, not a change.
- A change of the law of change with no fixed scheme, or a space of rules not given with the carrier: the tower's scheme is fixed, as the law of any stated process is.
- Whether the actual unfolding is a course of a process statable in advance; the possible that cannot be prestated is outside.
- That growth relative to what is held is better or is the direction of 生生: ranking needs C or a premise in its place, and the reading of 生生不息 here is an AI reading.
- A result no neighbouring field states: the held law restates open-ended novelty's innovation, and the tower law the finite degree of introspection of reflective towers.
- **Counterexample:** The rule changes at every step and every formation is possible everywhere, yet the possible with the rule held does not keep widening (Oscillating.converse_fails). Every moment is 全生成 under the rule held, so 全生成 does not give keeping widening (Oscillating.generation_without_widening). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)
- **Counterexample:** With every rule changed at once, 2 is possible from all rules at 1 but not with the rules from any height up held (Synchronous.tower_law_fails). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Each rule changes once, yet the possible with the rules from every height up held keeps widening (CopyDown.changes_iff, CopyDown.held_keeps_widening). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The possible with the rule held keeps widening while every formation is possible from every configuration of the course (RaisedRule.held_keeps_widening, RaisedRule.whole_every). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A course returning every two steps has the whole possible exceeding what is admitted at every step and the held possible widening across a step, yet it does not keep widening (Oscillating.returning_has_both). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The held possible keeps widening while every moment ceases under what is held (RaisedRule.ceases, CopyDown.ceases). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)
- **Counterexample:** For a relation that is not transitive, the moves holding it reach what is not alike the start; for one that is not symmetric, holding it as at the start reaches what holding it move by move does not (AdjacentHeld.differs, OrderHeld.differs). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HeldPossible.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The held law restates open-ended novelty's innovation, novelty that changes the model and with it the possibilities of variation (Banzhaf and others 2016), which holds there by definition, as a law on any process. Continuing inheritable change at the highest levels, which McMullin proposed at the York workshop (Taylor and others 2016), is the informal neighbour of a top fixed for good stopping the growth relative to it; innovation against fixed-rule systems, found with state-dependent rules (Adams, Zenil, Davies and Walker 2017), is a neighbour of the rule changing its own rule, not the same statement. The tower law's finite support is, in substance, the finite degree of introspection that lets an infinite tower of reflective processors be implemented (des Rivières and Smith 1984; Wand and Friedman 1988), restated with its premise shown needed; Bateson's levels of learning (1972) are the tower's scheme with no law of possibility. The possible that cannot be prestated (Kauffman 2000; Longo, Montévil and Kauffman 2012) is outside, and open-endedness relative to an observer (Hughes and others 2024) is an analogue on the side of novelty. Graded in UE11's NOTE.
